comment: Examples for DownloadSearchUIModelTest: what the 'Maps & Resources' search results screen shows for a query.
Nothing here is made up - the maps are every map the region tree of regions.ocbf offers and the cities are
searched in World_basemap_mini.obf, both shipped with the app, so these are the rows a user sees.
Every 'screen' entry is one row of the list: '[Header]' for a section header,
'Title' for a row without a second line and 'Title | Subtitle' for a row with the region shown in the second line.
Update the file when the shipped region data changes - the report the test writes shows the new screens side by side.

examples.name: Regions and maps with the same name are split into two sections
Country is shown in the second line, so equally named maps could be distinguished
Countries themselves have no second line
Comma separated terms are searched independently
Space separated terms must all be present in the name
Maps with the same name in different countries are told apart by the second line
A region whose map is built by joining its subregions has no map row of its own
screen: New York City and surroundings | United States
New York City and surroundings | United States

examples.name: A short query matches every name that starts with it, cities included
screen: New York City and surroundings | United States
Newcastle upon Tyne | North East England
New York City and surroundings | United States

examples.name: A partial second term still narrows the search down
Nothing is shown when there are no matches
Regions are hidden when the search is opened for a single download type
